prog='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        xs=[i for i,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
        for a,b in zip(xs,xs[1:]):
            for c in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=3
    return out
'''
